question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**and**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option is '**and**.'
 
• 'A**nd**' is used to connect two different words/phrases or ideas.
 
 
• **Example**:* I like burgers **and** pizza.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**So**' is used as a coordinating conjunction.
 
• '**Also**' is used when we have added a new point. 
 
• '**But**' is used when we say the same information but in a different way.
